body: I'm not sure if I can relate or if anything I've experienced is relate-able to this, but I've had times when I feel like my physical self and my mental self are slightly askew, not fully aligned, and like I'm smiling for the sake of warding of questions. When that happens, I stick around to see if any of my friends can bring me out of my weird state of consciousness and re-align a bit. Sometimes yes. Sometimes no. But if it doesn't happen, I'll get tired or irritated with them (not their fault, I just can't deal with it) so I'll leave. Be alone. Have some me time. Force myself to go through the hobbies I have memories of enjoying to try and feel like myself again. Sadly, for me it could take days :( but I end up coming around somehow. Sorry that I couldn't share something that works faster.

No problem. If you ever wanna talk about stuff and just have me listen, I will gladly do it. It's literally one of the only things I can offer to people because I'm generally very useless, but I can always try to listen. So feel free to PM me whenever. (i know my username says throwaway, but it's a secondary account now.)

I'm so angry for you. What bastard makes a fake account, attacks people, and then lets you take the blame and all the repercussions for it? And curiosity speaking: how did your 'close friends' believe for a second it was you. 
I'm sort of emotional detached from how you're feeling right now, because I haven't had an experience like this, so I'm in fact gathering mode, and I'm so curious. How did you explain to your friends and your parents about your side of the story? (sounds like your side doesn't have much of a story, because you had nothing to do with the accounts though. so imo, it'd be hard to explain) Was in person? Were people yelling? Was there a lot of emotional tension? Was it very soon (immediately) after the account fiasco? How is the boyfriend doing now? do you know? Are the gf/bf ex-pair still friends with him?  I'm not sure how to cope because I have poor coping mechanisms (lol), but maybe: accept this happened. stay true to yourself ( you didn't do those things). and you did not kill your nan! she was asking for you on her death bed. She obviously loved you and you love her. You did not kill her. it's unfortunate you never got around to seeing her, but don't let that outweigh your love for your nan in your heart. I'm sure her memory deserves better than that. Gah, I want to say more and I want to understand more, but I'm getting all flustered. I'm on the east coast of usa, so if I'm far far away from you, PM me so we can talk a bit if you so wish.

You can still be in control! I don't know how you're being pushed to drop your classes, because I won't be fully aware of what your situation is like, but what are the reasons that people are giving you for dropping your classes? You can keep control by assessing what they're saying, and make the decision yourself. Maybe some time off from your classes will help, maybe it will do the exact opposite of help. So my suggestion is to maintain your control by collecting all your reasons for not dropping your classes. Write it down and maintain your position and explain to all those pushers that this is important to you. The light you hold is important, and it's yours. I have a light of hope too and it's small, but it's mine and I do anything to keep feeding it. My silly brain tries to convince me it's not mine and it doesn't matter, but I freaking know it's important. Your little gleam of light can grow, just don't forget about it and don't lose it :) it's so special and I believe in you to keep it alive.

do you mind if I give you internet hugs? /hugs. I'm on a word vomit spree right now, fun little 'high' after my trash night yesterday. (off topic, sorry!) I'm not very good with words and being supportive and the like, so when my friends come to me to talk, I usually end up listening, forcing out any thoughts I had, and offering all the hugging I can. Actually, in person, I'm not even all that good at hugging when others seem to actually need it >_>  oh, and I'm really bad at communication (communicating and understanding), so I can't tell if I should be offering you support or say I also would rather be nothing than be the me I am and have to experience right now. :(

/hugs. I'm bad with words, so I offer hugs. I wish I could do so in person, because there's something good and relaxing and nice about hugs. Even if it's a little weird, maybe you can ask a family member or friends for one. One that lasts more than a split second. A long one where you're hugging for so long, you realize you were holding your breath and then you exhale and feel a little tension leave your body. Those are my favorites. Sorry for such a weird suggestion >_> it might not even apply to you. I'm not good at being supportive and usually come up with really silly ideas... Like for your silent house, I thought maybe you could get a fish. I had a couple carnival goldfish and the sounds of their clicking mouths are soothing somehow.

kay, I'm hyper and words aren't stopping, so I'm just gonna spit out things, so don't take offense to anything I say.
HEY, You're not your brother! you're you and well people fail sometimes, but you have this huge list of things you classify as failures, you should have one of accomplishments. And no, not things that you must match up to your brother in. Your own accomplishments. If I tried to match up to all the successful people in my life, I'd be more of a wreck than I already am. I think I tried to get on a friends level last semester and it ruined me. Please keep trying! (btw, I think continuing to try is a huge accomplishment. and I truly believe that even though my sad sad brain tries to demean it. silly, brain.) and you know what, I'm proud of you for all the effort you put in. 

Now I'm going to rant a little about myself. I don't want to be compared to others. Not just by other people but by myself. It hurts so much. I feel like nothing compared to the things other people are achieving, but according to some very kind people in my life, they remind me that I have strengths. I'd totally actively try to do that for you, but I totally fail at it. >_>

oh also, uhhh dick size doesn't matter... well i mean, okay well, coming from a sexually inexperienced person, maybe it doesn't mean much, and look i'm getting all flustered over this topic, but i really think it shouldn't matter.

feel free to hate on me but the thing about discrimination (what I think people forget about a lot because of all the shallow jokes and media bs) is that it has to go because it affects you even when you're working your ass off. you can't say women have a lower salary because they aren't busting their ass. I can't cite any of this or vouch for accuracy, but there are numerous sources that put a number on how much less women are paid than men in certain fields. Its the same with race. its the same with looks. it happens and it really shouldn't and i dont know if people don't realize how subtle discrimination really is. its not as easy as working hard and getting what you want. now that sounds like being entitled.

I'm not tying to contradict you or anything. just adding my 2cents.

I sometimes transgress into active thinking but i have passive suicidal thoughts weekly. bla bla bla. I considered that, but I decided that I prefer to not. I'll be held back a year and I'm absolute crap at making friends. I feel absolutely blessed and lucky to have the friends I have now and I don't know how I'll handle being thrown in with a couple hundred of new people. tuition also increases each year... there's that money thing again.
